question.text: Given that, $x$ is a real number satisfying $\frac{5 x^{2}-26 x+5}{3 x^{2}-10 x+3}    < 0,$ then

solution.text:
We have, $\frac{5 x^{2}-26 x+5}{3 x^{2}-10 x+3}    < 0$
$\Rightarrow \quad \frac{5 x^{2}-25 x-x+5}{3 x^{2}-9 x-x+3} < 0$
$\Rightarrow \quad \frac{5 x(x-5)-1(x-5)}{3 x(x-3)-1(x-3)} < 0 \Rightarrow \frac{(x-5)(5 x-1)}{(x-3)(3 x-1)} < 0$
$\therefore \quad x \in\left(\frac{1}{5}, \frac{1}{3}\right) \cup(3,5)$
